name: capture engine Pods
command: kubectl get pods -n liangjiahao -l app\ in\ \(prefill\,decode\) -o json

name: assert engine identity
command:
jq -er --arg image docker.io/library/vllm-ascend:kv-pool-layerwise-main-54503ece-a2-45b2e785-df3f74ed-20260807T100722Z --arg config sha256:eca977c2db3e6a45c331087298b0592cfa2af3794b39c06f03dc54219a7bba2b $'
    (.items | length) == 2 and
    all(.items[];
      .metadata.deletionTimestamp == null and .status.phase == "Running" and
      .spec.nodeName == "n1" and .spec.containers[0].image == $image and
      .status.containerStatuses[0].imageID == $config and
      .status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount == 0 and
      .spec.containers[0].resources.requests["huawei.com/Ascend910"] == "1" and
      .spec.containers[0].resources.limits["huawei.com/Ascend910"] == "1")' /root/ljh/vllm-workspace/features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260807T100722Z/g4/engine-pods.json

name: preflight stop Decode

name: start debug Decode

name: assert Decode debug env

name: capture proxy endpoints
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao prefill-engine-deployment-868546d9f5-g56hb -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c $'\nfrom urllib.request import urlopen\nprint(urlopen("http://vllm-proxy-service:8000/listEndPoints", timeout=10).read().decode(), end="")'

name: sync request fixture
command: bash -o pipefail -c tar\ -C\ \"\$1\"\ -cf\ -\ request.json\ \|\ kubectl\ exec\ -i\ -n\ liangjiahao\ \"\$2\"\ -c\ prefill-engine\ --\ tar\ -C\ \"\$3\"\ -xf\ - bash /root/ljh/vllm-workspace/features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260807T100722Z/g4 prefill-engine-deployment-868546d9f5-g56hb /tmp/full-validation-20260807T100722Z/g4

name: send G4 proxy request
command:
kubectl exec -n liangjiahao prefill-engine-deployment-868546d9f5-g56hb -c prefill-engine -- env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
payload = Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()
response = urlopen(Request(sys.argv[1], payload, {"Content-Type": "application/json"}), timeout=600)
body = response.read()
Path(sys.argv[3]).write_bytes(body)
print(response.status)
assert response.status == 200' http://vllm-proxy-service:8000/v1/completions /tmp/full-validation-20260807T100722Z/g4/request.json /tmp/full-validation-20260807T100722Z/g4/response.json

name: capture Decode log
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao decode-engine-deployment-598b59d746-fmbpp -c decode-engine -- cat /tmp/vllm-decode.log

name: stop Decode
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao decode-engine-deployment-598b59d746-fmbpp -c decode-engine -- /opt/vllm-layerwise/stop-engine.sh decode
